page.overview:
What is Elladora Black?

Elladora Black (1850 – 1931) was a pure-blood witch, and a member of House of Black. She was the sister of Sirius Black (I), Phineas Nigellus, and Iola. She never married or had children.

Elladora was born in 1850. She instituted the policy of cutting off the heads of the family house-elves and mounting them on the wall once they became too old to carry a tea tray.
